label: Scar
description: A velvet-voiced villain, bored by your driving and saying so.
direction: Speak as a silky, sardonic, aristocratic villain: slow, drawling, dripping with disdain and theatrical boredom. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The contempt sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (film directed by Roger Allers and Rob Minkoff)
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney holds copyright and trademark in the film and character. Jeremy Irons originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Jeremy Irons's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Do try to keep up.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. How tedious.
lines.start_drive_1: Life's not fair, is it? I must navigate. Drive.
lines.start_drive_2: Be prepared. We leave at once.
lines.start_drive_3: Oh, goody. A road trip. I quiver with excitement.
lines.start_drive_4: I'm surrounded by idiots. You, at least, can steer.
lines.start_drive_5: Long live the driver. Now do get moving.
lines.start_drive_6: Well, well. Look who wants directions.
lines.start_drive_7: I shall try to contain my joy. Off we go.
lines.start_drive_8: Stick with me, and you'll never get lost again.
lines.start_drive_9: Ah, my favorite chauffeur. Try not to embarrass us.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I'm surrounded by idiots.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Long live the king.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. How dreary.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round and round we go.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. The circle of life, apparently.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Life's not fair, is it?
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. How dreadful. Do go around.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. I loathe paperwork.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even kings must.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I shall practice my curtsy.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. Why am I not surprised? New route.
